name: yimoku
description: Dev-only tooling for the YiMoku test suite. The game itself ships as one zero-dependency HTML file — this package never affects what the browser loads.
author: lingyicute

scripts.test: node tests/offline-contract.js && node tests/worker-contract.js && node tests/selftest.js && npm run test:ai && node tests/smoke.js && node tests/session.js
